description: Reranking compared on SQuAD and ConditionalQA: none against bge-reranker-v2-m3 over all 50 retrieved chunks, keeping 10, on the same indexes. It is the only reranker the endpoint serves. The other stages are at the README's baseline: fixed_token chunking, its max_tokens and overlap swept so that compare.py reports each alternative at its best, no augmentation, bge-m3, dense retrieval, no reranking. Run: .venv\Scripts\python.exe experiments.py experiments/reranking_eval_squad_conditionalqa.json
